[中文](#cn-v0.4.1) | [English](#en-v0.4.1)

**一次结构性重构 —— 行为不许变，而且证明了它没变。** 起因是一次代码体检，
结论是**代码本身健康**，问题只在可维护性上；所以这一版**不夹带任何功能**。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.1">新增功能</h3>

**本版不夹带新功能。** 唯一的输出变化是下面这一处（属修复，在这里列出因为它是新字段）：
原型文档读取的返回里多了 `projectInfoError`（正常时为 `null`）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.1">体验优化</h3>

- **拆长函数**：

  | 函数 | 前 | 后 |
  |---|---|---|
  | `main`（CLI） | **351 行**（17 个 `case` 挤在一个 `switch`） | **26 行**（解析 + 分发 + 统一错误）+ **16 个 `cmdXxx`** + `CLI_COMMANDS` 命令表 |
  | `normalizeAxurePage` | **292 行** | **176 行** + 新纯函数 **`axureNodeFields`**（每节点的几何/颜色/字体/描边/圆角/内边距） |
  | `compareBlockProps` | **173 行** | **21 行** + **6 个比较器**（`cmpRadius` / `cmpSize` / `cmpTextColor` / `cmpFontWeight` / `cmpFill` / `cmpBorder`） |

- **URL 解析入口收敛**：找到并删掉了一处**真重复** —— `parseProductUrl` 自己抄了一份与 `lanhuUrlParams`
  **逐行相同**的参数抽取循环；删掉后**全文件只剩 1 处**。并写下两层分工说明：
  底层 `lanhuUrlParams`（只抽参数不校验）；上层按语义分三个入口（某一张稿 / 某个项目 / 一份原型文档）；`resolveTarget` 只做胶水。
  **导出名一个没改**，且**反向断言仍在**：`parseLanhuUrl` 必须继续要求 `image_id`（不许为统一而改宽容）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.1">问题修复</h3>

- **两处静默吞错改成留痕**：`multiInfo(...).catch(() => null)` → 新增 `tryProjectInfo()` → `{ info, error }`。
  仍然降级（项目信息是锦上添花，不许因此让整次调用失败），但**不再无声**：
  机器读 `projectInfoError`，人读给一句 `> ⚠️ 项目信息未取到（原因）—— 不影响下面的结果`。**正常时零变化。**
- 删掉死导出 `PW_INSTALL_HINT`。删之前先查清它是**已发布 5 个版本的别名**（不是"预留"，也不是"被重命名的旧名" ——
  证据是两个名字**自首个公开版就并存**）。

<h3 id="cn-v0.4.1">其他变更</h3>

- **验证方式：黄金输出对比。** 重构**之前**先采基线：**24 条 CLI 命令**（stdout/stderr/退出码）+
  **19 个工具调用**（`text` 与**返回对象字段名集合**）；重构后跑同一脚本、归一化后**逐字节 diff**。
  **44 份里 41 份逐字节相同**，3 处差异全部可解释（其中两处**只**多了一个字段，而 `text` 长度
  1954B / 2797B **前后一致**）。也先证明了**基线自身确定**：两次独立采集 → 归一化后 **0 差异**。
- **过程中自检抓到一个真回归**：重写 `main` 时漏了打印用法 → 无参调用变成**零输出**
  （正是本项目最忌讳的"看着跑成功但什么都没干"），当场判红、补回才绿。
- 自检 **564 → 569 项**；变异测试 3 处全红。
- 新记入「已知空缺」：**CLI 不支持指定账号** —— `search` / `projects` 这类只给 id 的命令只传 cookie，
  走**默认账号**，非默认账号会报 `30005`；而工具的 `account` 参数是好的。**下个版本补 `--account`。**

**Full Changelog**: [v0.4.0...v0.4.1](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1)

---

<h3 id="en-v0.4.1">New Features</h3>

**No new features ship in this release.** The only output change is listed under Bug Fixes below (it is a new field):
prototype document reads now return `projectInfoError` (`null` in the normal case).

<h3 id="en-v0.4.1">Improvements</h3>

- **Long functions split**:

  | Function | Before | After |
  |---|---|---|
  | `main` (CLI) | **351 lines** (17 `case`s in one `switch`) | **26 lines** (parse + dispatch + unified errors) + **16 `cmdXxx` handlers** + a `CLI_COMMANDS` table |
  | `normalizeAxurePage` | **292 lines** | **176 lines** + a new pure function **`axureNodeFields`** (per-node geometry/colour/font/border/radius/padding) |
  | `compareBlockProps` | **173 lines** | **21 lines** + **6 comparators** (`cmpRadius` / `cmpSize` / `cmpTextColor` / `cmpFontWeight` / `cmpFill` / `cmpBorder`) |

- **URL parsing entry points consolidated**: real duplication was found and removed — `parseProductUrl` had **copied,
  line for line**, the parameter-extraction loop already in `lanhuUrlParams`; afterwards **the file contains exactly one
  such loop**. A two-layer description was written down: `lanhuUrlParams` at the bottom (extracts without validating),
  three semantic entry points above (one artboard / one project / one prototype document), and `resolveTarget` as glue.
  **No export was renamed**, and the **reverse assertion still holds**: `parseLanhuUrl` must keep requiring `image_id`.

<h3 id="en-v0.4.1">Bug Fixes</h3>

- **Two silent swallows now leave a trace**: `multiInfo(...).catch(() => null)` → new `tryProjectInfo()` → `{ info, error }`.
  It still degrades gracefully (project info is a nice-to-have and must never fail the whole call), but no longer
  silently: machine-readable `projectInfoError`, and a human-readable
  `> ⚠️ 项目信息未取到（原因）—— 不影响下面的结果`. **Zero change on the normal path.**
- Removed the dead export `PW_INSTALL_HINT`. Before deleting it, we established that it is an **alias that shipped in
  five released versions** — not a placeholder and not an old name left over from a rename (both names have coexisted
  since the first public release).

<h3 id="en-v0.4.1">Chores</h3>

- **How this was verified: golden-output diffing.** The baseline was captured **before** touching any code —
  **24 CLI commands** (stdout/stderr/exit code) and **19 tool calls** (`text` plus the **set of returned field names**) —
  then re-captured after the refactor with the same script, normalised and **diffed byte by byte**.
  **41 of 44 files are byte-identical**; the 3 differences are all explained (two of them **only** add one field, while
  `text` lengths 1954B / 2797B are **unchanged**). The baseline itself was first shown to be deterministic:
  two independent captures → **0 differences** after normalisation.
- **The self-check caught a real regression during the work**: rewriting `main` dropped the usage text, making a no-argument
  run produce **no output at all** — exactly the "looks successful but did nothing" failure this project fights.
  It went red immediately and was fixed.
- Self-check **564 → 569 assertions**; all 3 mutations turn red.
- Recorded under known gaps: **the CLI cannot target an account** — `search` / `projects` pass only a cookie and therefore
  use the **default account**, failing with `30005` for non-default accounts, while the tools' `account` parameter works.
  `--account` is to be added next version.

**Full Changelog**: [v0.4.0...v0.4.1](https://github.com/LoktLin/dsh-lanhu/compare/v0.4.0...v0.4.1)
